incident.trigger: KubeSolo did not shut down cleanly (crash, fatal error, kill or power loss)

recentErrors: 2026-10-15T09:01:45Z kine: SQLite integrity check failed. The SQLite WAL artefacts may be corrupt after an unclean shutdown. Remove /var/lib/kubesolo/kine/db/state.db-wal and /var/lib/kubesolo/kine/db/state.db-shm manually, or restart with --db-wal-repair to remove them automatically.

triage.summary: KubeSolo experienced an unclean shutdown with SQLite WAL corruption detected in the kine datastore.
triage.cause: The kine database is damaged, matching the knowledge entry for 'database disk image is malformed' or 'file is not a database' from SQLite integrity check failures.
